articles.title: New Federal Data Shows How U.S. Public School Students Are Doing
articles.summary: A big federal survey of more than 97,000 public schools shows more preschoolers, more suspensions and a teacher workforce less diverse than students.

articles.title: ABC Asks Judge to Stop Early Government Review of Its TV Station Licenses
articles.summary: ABC told a federal judge that an early FCC review of its station licenses threatens free speech. The government says the court is the wrong place for the case.

articles.title: Leaders From Both Parties Back a New Bike and Walking Bridge Over the Ohio River
articles.summary: Ohio and West Virginia towns want to replace a closed, rusted bridge with one that carries a cross-country bike and walking trail.
